title: Evaluating the Underlying Gender Bias in Contextualized Word Embeddings

bias_targets.methodology: The paper evaluates gender bias in contextualized word embeddings (ELMo) through multiple methods: (1) detecting the gender space using Principal Component Analysis (PCA) on the vector differences of definitional male/female word pairs, (2) measuring 'Direct Bias' by calculating the cosine similarity between profession words and the gender direction, (3) applying K-means clustering to see if male and female biased words group together, (4) using an SVM classification approach to test if embeddings learn to generalize bias, and (5) applying a K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) approach to analyze the percentage of stereotyped professions among the closest neighbors of profession tokens.
